details: Every workflow checker whose transcript has attachment entries after its prompt gets no mark, silently (the systemMessage is lost in a workflow); the merge is then refused "no check mark". The second failure of this hook on the workflow transcript shape (first: the harness relay line, fixed 24 Oct).
failing_case: 24 Oct, wt/guard-test-name: check JSON open 0 recorded, no mark committed; replaying the hook on agent-a9142df3e17c5ca29.jsonl (line 0 the workflow prompt with Report:, lines 1-3 attachment entries) prints "check mark not written for this worktree: the checker's transcript does not start with a prompt".
pass_cases: That transcript shape (labelled prompt, then attachment entries, then assistant) writes the mark; a transcript with no prompt at all still says "does not start with a prompt"; the harness-relay-first case of the earlier fix still picks the labelled entry.
findings.summary: A workflow checker gets no mark when attachments follow

scope: From queue item a-workflow-checker-gets-no-mark-when-attachments: the fix is checked as finding Q1.
